title: The Microflora Danica atlas of Danish environmental microbiomes
use_summary: The authors used wesanderson0.3.7 to construct the color scale for MFOD1 ontology levels. They separately used viridisLite0.4.2 for colorblind-friendly continuous gradients.
review_scope: Complete primary Methods paragraph93 and a known-palette-identifier scan of the primary XML; supplementary analysis code is not audited here.
